survey.name: MITHNEOS Marsset et al. (2022) Table 7
survey.record_layout: Journal machine-readable Table 7; byte offsets 1-32 filename, 34-39 number, 41-50 designation, 124-129 taxonomy; source includes the complete byte-layout header.

source_reading.scope: Sections 2.1-2.2 on survey and taxonomy; 3.1 on selection/debiasing; Appendix E Table 7 definitions. Near-infrared C/X degeneracy, uncertain colon flags and low-SNR exclusion are implemented; published global debiasing weights are not transplanted.
Complete catalogue description and byte layout, checked against journal original and retrieved CDS Harvard mirror.
Survey provenance, spectral coverage and data-use statement. MIT calls the spectra public domain and requests acknowledgement; that statement is not extended to every publisher-hosted derivative.
spkid, full_name, orbital and spectral-type query field definitions.

rights_scope: The full publisher table and catalogue mirror remain ignored external inputs. The committed product contains derived summaries, object-level joins and minimal identifying classifications with citation. No redistribution permission for the full publisher-hosted table is inferred from the MIT spectra data-use statement.
aggregation: Each matched JPL object is counted once. Source classes remain attached to observations. Colon uncertainty is recorded; double-colon low-SNR and U are excluded from usable groups. Subclasses are grouped only by explicit mapping; cross-family disagreements remain conflicts. No majority vote or SNR ranking is invented.
limits: Observed-sample fractions are not an unbiased NEA population estimate. Discovery, brightness, size, sky access, observing choices, albedo screening and frozen-catalogue membership affect selection.
Taxonomy is a spectral resemblance, not a water, nitrogen or metal assay; no resource grade, recovery or reserve quantity is derived.
JPL and MITHNEOS can cite overlapping underlying observations. Their union adds catalogue coverage, not independent statistical samples.

The source paper reports 420 objects; published Table 7 has 419 distinct number/designation identities and 420 filename prefixes because numbered 381677 is also au2009bj81. The implementation preserves this discrepancy.

Uniform density 1500 kg/m3 and spherical diameter-derived volumes are inherited screening assumptions, not measured masses. Missing diameters retain unknown mass. Completion scenarios and finite-catalogue identification bounds are conditional on accepted labels; neither is a statistically unbiased composition estimate.
